primary_factors: NWS point forecast for Rockford shows rain Sunday, then mainly dry Sunday night with a low around 32°F; Monday is partly sunny with a high near 38°F (no wintry precipitation indicated during school hours).
Your hourly forecast also shows no precipitation 1–11 a.m. Monday, with temperatures ~32–35°F and light-to-moderate winds—so no blowing/drifting snow signal.

Main potential hazard is *black ice* early Monday if roads stay wet from Sunday rain and some surfaces dip to/below freezing near daybreak; pavement temperatures and exact drying/refreeze timing are unknown.
NWS Grand Rapids discussion notes a small chance of snow mixing in Sunday night, but says accumulating snow chances look low and travel impacts are not expected beyond wet roads at times.
decision_rationale:
Based on the provided hourly forecast, Monday morning (2026-11-30) is forecast to be dry with temps near freezing (around 32–35°F). That setup usually does *not* support a districtwide full-day closure by itself; the one thing that could still cause problems is refreezing/black ice from Sunday rainfall.

External evidence used (available before the issue time):
- NWS Point Forecast for Rockford, MI (updated 6:05 AM EST Fri Nov 27, 2026) shows: Sunday ‘Showers’ (90%), Sunday night ‘30% chance of showers before 1am’ with low around 32°F, and Monday ‘Partly sunny’ high near 38°F. - NWS Grand Rapids Area Forecast Discussion (product timestamp 5:58 AM EST Fri Nov 27, 2026; discussion text notes colder air Sunday night into Monday, possible snow mix Sunday night but accumulating snow chances look low; ‘no real impacts to travel are expected except for some wet roads at times’). URL: `https://forecast.weather.gov/product.php?format=txt&issuedby=GRR&product=AFD`. ([forecast.weather.gov](https://forecast.weather.gov/product.php?format=txt&glossary=0&issuedby=GRR&product=AFD&site=BOX&version=1))

What’s unknown right now (and matters): how long rain lasts Sunday evening, how quickly roads dry, and whether pavement temps fall below 32°F near daybreak Monday. Those details can swing this toward a delay, but a full-day closure still looks unlikely from the current forecast signal.
